description:
Migrate the Winograd crossover to a resolved-once runtime read.

## Background

The proof-surface seam design (dev/active/7d7c647c/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §3 fixes the three-part seam with probe-verified surface claims, §4 gives each field its name, kind, range, default-naming constant, mechanism and route-observation obligation, §5 records the decisions (D1 direct removal, D2 lane split, D3 opaque pin, D4 default naming, D5 public reporters, D6 source-level convention amendments), §6 enumerates the post-processing deletions, and §8 scopes the tasks. The follow-on migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) supplies the shared field-kind, mechanism and test conventions.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: gemm_winograd resolves gemm.winograd_min_dim once through tuning::active() and threads it into gemm_winograd_with_threshold; the comparison is unchanged and the read-pattern obligations hold.
- [hard] REQ-02: winograd_route is public, #[must_use], called by the dispatcher; installed-profile route files above and below the boundary pass, and the existing bit-exactness property tests pass on the conservative table.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rustdoc names the profile field; behaviour with no profile installed is unchanged.
title: Cut the Winograd threshold over to the tuning profile
